name: verifiers (Prime Intellect)
def: "our library for creating environments to train and evaluate LLMs", tied to the Environments Hub and prime-rl
abs: v1 concepts: Taskset (rows plus hooks, tools, metrics, rewards), Harness ("the program the model is run in, e.g. Claude Code, Codex or mini-swe-agent"), Agent (harness x model x runtime policy), Environment, Toolset (MCP servers), Trace (messages, rewards, per-call records, tokens and logprobs). The older dataset plus rubric API was removed in v1.

name: OpenEnv (Hugging Face, Meta PyTorch)
def: "An e2e framework for creating, deploying and using isolated execution environments for agentic RL training, built using Gymnasium style simple APIs" (marked experimental)
abs: reset(), step(action), state(); results carry observation and reward; environments are Docker containers behind HTTP, deployable to Hugging Face Spaces; MCP tool actions

name: NeMo Gym (NVIDIA)
def: "a library for evaluating and improving models and agents using environments"
abs: An environment is "a dataset (tasks to solve), an agent harness ..., a verifier (task completion scoring), and state"; verification in resources servers; rewards can be recomputed from stored rollouts

name: rLLM
def: "Bring any harness, run it in any sandbox, and switch training backends with one flag"
abs: @rllm.rollout (the agent) and @rllm.evaluator returning a reward; backends verl, tinker, fireworks; GRPO, REINFORCE, RLOO, SFT. DeepSWE was trained with it.

name: SkyRL and SkyRL-Gym
def: "A Modular Full-stack RL Library for LLMs"; SkyRL-Gym: "A library of RL environments for LLMs implemented with the Gymnasium API"
abs: Gymnasium-style environments; per-turn loss masks with observation tokens always masked; token-in, token-out generation

name: ART (OpenPipe)
def: "Agent Reinforcement Trainer: train multi-step agents for real-world tasks using GRPO"
abs: Your code runs the agent, stores messages in a Trajectory and "assigns a reward to its Trajectory"; RULER gives LLM-judged rewards

name: Harbor (Terminal-Bench team)
def: "a framework from the creators of Terminal-Bench for evaluating and optimizing agents and language models"; official harness for Terminal-Bench 2.0; can generate rollouts for RL
abs: A task is a folder: instruction.md, task.toml, environment/ (Dockerfile), solution/solve.sh, tests/test.sh, which must write a numeric reward to /logs/verifier/reward.txt or reward.json
